note: Recognition/structural conversion availability is NOT independent native-engine parity. Unknown generic source types must be reported. animation.track.detail: Unreal animation/transform track construction; skeletal, interpolation and blending parity remain unverified.

camera.transform.detail: Camera transforms and field-of-view conversion; final framing unverified.

camera.cut.detail: Creates Camera Cut tracks from recognized source sections.

audio.track.detail: Audio sections only; waveform/mixing and fades not verified.

event.trigger.detail: Signals become timed markers, not executed payloads.

light.animation.detail: Experimental light intensity curves; physical illumination unverified.

event.state.detail: Activation/enable-state semantics not yet implemented as equivalent Unreal behavior.

animation.root_motion.detail: Recognized Unity animation root-translation/rotation curves; clip-level root motion, hierarchy and rig parity need independent verification.

animation.bone_curve.detail: Recognized source humanoid muscle/bone channel; Unreal skeletal rig retargeting and sampled pose correspondence are not established.

animation.offset.detail: Recognized source-authored track, clip or infinite animation offset metadata; exact target composition/ordering must be verified.
